verdict.rationale: Groq's first-party Batch API docs describe submitting workloads as an asynchronous batch at a documented 50% lower cost than real-time, with a 24-hour to 7-day processing window and no impact on standard rate limits. The billing FAQ confirms batch processing is unlocked on paid tiers. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that batch jobs deliver the documented discount in practice.
